name: Itsutsuji Mitone
source:
A teacher at St.Trea Academy. Advisor of the puzzle club. She is a cheerful and friendly teacher, but she can't hide her sexiness. 

She is always frank with her students and her teaching style is easy to understand. She is popular with both male and female students alike.
